theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have h₁ : ∀ i, 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d := by
    intro i
    have h₂ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) := (hrelation d e).mp h.1 |>.2 i
    have h₃ : digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) = (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d := by
      calc
        digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) = ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then e j else d j) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) := by simp [hdigits_to_num]
        _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (d j + (if j = i then e j - d j else 0)) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          by_cases h : j = i
          · simp [h] <;> ring
          · simp [h] <;> ring
        _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (d j * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) + (if j = i then e j - d j else 0) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          ring
        _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, d j * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) + ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then e j - d j else 0) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by simp [hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ]
        _ = (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d := by ring
    rw [h₃] at h₂
    exact h₂
  have h₂ : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
    have h₃ : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9, ((e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) := by
      apply Finset.dvd_sum
      intro i _
      exact h₁ i
    have h₄ : ∑ i : Fin 9, ((e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) = ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp [Finset.sum_const, Fintype.card_fin]
    rw [h₄] at h₃
    exact h₃
  have h₃ : digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d = ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    calc
      digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d = ∑ i : Fin 9, e i * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) - ∑ i : Fin 9, d i * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by simp [hdigits_to_num]
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        <;> simp
  rw [h₃.symm] at h₂
  have h₄ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    have h₅ : (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d) + 9 * digits_to_num d = digits_to_num e + 8 * digits_to_num d := by ring
    rw [h₅] at h₂
    have h₆ : 8 * digits_to_num d = digits_to_num d + 7 * digits_to_num d := by ring
    rw [h₆] at h₂
    have h₇ : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num d := by use digits_to_num d; ring
    have h₈ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d + 7 * digits_to_num d := by
      rw [add_assoc] at h₂
      exact h₂
    exact dvd_sub h₈ h₇
  have h₅ : ∀ i, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    intro i
    have h₆ : 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e := by
      have h₇ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) := (hrelation e f).mp h.2 |>.2 i
      have h₈ : digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) = (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e := by
        calc
          digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) = ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then f j else e j) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) := by simp [hdigits_to_num]
          _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (e j + (if j = i then f j - e j else 0)) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j _
            by_cases h : j = i
            · simp [h] <;> ring
            · simp [h] <;> ring
          _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (e j * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) + (if j = i then f j - e j else 0) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j _
            ring
          _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, e j * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) + ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then f j - e j else 0) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          _ = digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by simp [hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ]
          _ = (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e := by ring
      rw [h₈] at h₇
      exact h₇
    have h₉ : (f i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) = ((f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e) + (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)) - (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d) := by ring
    rw [h₉]
    have h₁₀ : 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e := h₆
    have h₁₁ : 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d := h₁ i
    have h₁₂ : 7 ∣ (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)) := by rw [add_comm]; exact h₁₁
    exact dvd_add (dvd_add h₁₀ h₁₂) (dvd_neg.mpr h₄)
  have h₆ : ∀ i, 7 ∣ f i - d i := by
    intro i
    have h₇ : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := h₅ i
    have h₈ : ¬(7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      intro h₉
      have h₁₀ : (7 : ℕ) ∣ (10 : ℕ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by norm_cast at h₉ ⊢; exact h₉
      have h₁₁ : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := by exact Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow (by decide) h₁₀
      norm_num at h₁₁
    have h₉ : (7 : ℤ) ∣ f i - d i ∨ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      apply (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by decide)).dvd_mul.mp
      exact h₇
    cases h₉ with
    | inl h₉ => exact h₉
    | inr h₉ => exact h₈ h₉
  intro i
  exact h₆ i
